mechanism_narrative: A rebound in TRANSIT from its late-March trough to current levels signals renewed trip-making that raises retail footfall within four weeks. failure_condition: If TRANSIT does not recover from its current level and RETAIL_REC stays at or below the last-4-week mean over the next 28 days, the mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays elevated while WORKPLACES remain deeply negative, more activity is displaced into home-based spending and local neighborhood errands, which lifts retail/recreation demand with a short lag. Under this substitution pattern, RETAIL_REC should improve over the next two weeks if work mobility does not recover.
